SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT NVL(INTERFACE_ID,' ') AS INTERFACE_ID FROM KEP.T02_KEP_UNITCOST_DENG WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT INTERFACE_ID ,ITEMCODE ,KEPCODE ,UNITPRICE ,SUPPLIERID ,MAKER ,CONTRACTYEAR ,ITEMNAME ,UNITTYPE ,SPEC ,REMARK ,DELIVERYDATE ,CATE1 ,CATE2 ,CATE3 ,CATE4 ,MADEIN ,PROCESS_CODE ,ERROR_MESSAGE ,INTERFACE_DATE ,IF_FLAG ,STATUS FROM KEP.T02_KEP_UNITCOST_DENG WHERE INTERFACE_ID = '$G_RS.INTERFACE_ID$'
UPDATE KEP.T02_KEP_UNITCOST_DENG SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', INTERFACE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE INTERFACE_ID = '$G_RS.INTERFACE_ID$'
UPDATE KEP.T02_KEP_UNITCOST_DENG SET IF_FLAG = 'E', INTERFACE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE INTERFACE_ID = '$G_RS.INTERFACE_ID$'
